mechanisms: Force the harmony analysis-to-final switch <|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>final<|message|> (ids 200007, 200006, 173781, 200005, 17196, 200008) token by token when a reasoning budget is exhausted.
JUICE soft landing: write the lab's plain-text wrap-up nudge into the analysis once at the soft budget, before the hard close.
modifications: Reimplemented inside mlx2's ThinkingGuard instead of a per-lane force deque. Which marker or nudge token comes next is a pure function of the generated ids, so speculative verify rows and rollbacks need no forcing state.
The release ramp boosts the next marker token after any prefix the model already wrote. A forced close continues that prefix and does not restart it.
The nudge is skipped when nudge plus close marker do not fit before the hard budget. The receipt reports it as 'nudged'.
The JUICE budget ladder already existed in mlx2 (resolve_thinking_budget, EFFORT_SCALE). It now drives the multi-token guard.

New: a thinking-off Puzzle request still reasons (hidden, Reasoning: low). It gets an adapter-declared hidden budget: (max_tokens - 6) * 2 // 3, between 1 and 512; two thirds beat one half 137/150 vs 130/150 (hidden-split-battery.json).

not_ported.CHAIN routing steering (chain_steering.p: Measured on Puzzle-88B q6dense with a test-only port (qualification/experiments/gpt-oss-harmony-20260930/chain-battery.json, 30 prompts x 6 small-budget configs, greedy). Guard+JUICE scored 146/180 and +CHAIN 144/180: 6 fixes vs 8 breaks, sign-test p=0.79. CHAIN halved final-channel run-ons (12 to 6) but broke arithmetic and date answers. This matches the lab's own closeout that k=1 is a stability choice, not a quality lever.

validation: CPU unit and engine tests: multi-token forced close identical across ordinary, native-MTP, physical-MTP and prompt-lookup routes; randomized rollback purity with and without the nudge; hidden budget including history mode; parser header and fallback cases. GPU served-path runs on gpt-oss-puzzle-88B-q6dense and gpt-oss-20b are recorded under qualification/experiments/gpt-oss-harmony-20260930/.
